stage.name: Kurfürstenplatz
stage.description:
The 'Echoes of Herkunftshorn'—they seek to carry on the Witch King's melody. Play now, rescue team from Rhodes Island; drown out the chaotic, resentful, and paranoid notes with your own melody. The Kurfürstenplatz should witness the most beautiful sunset.
<Special Condition>DP will not regenerate naturally.
<Tuning Node>Heals when attacked; when activated during a song variation, changes the variation and briefly applies a buff to friendly units.

remnant_orchestra_flautist.name: Remnant Orchestra Flautist
remnant_orchestra_flautist.flavourText: Flautist who wants to join their king's orchestra. This nobody has never seen the spectacle, and is all the more fanatical for it.
abilities: After 2 attacks, the next attack has increased ATK

street_drunk.name: 'Street Drunk'
street_drunk.flavourText: Armed militants disguised as Infected, they are overly acquainted with the local situation, to the point that they have become alcoholics hanging around the street pubs, their mission long forgotten.
abilities: When attacking targets outside of Realigned Flux, deals a certain percentage of Arts damage

witch_kings_orchestra_flautist.name: Witch King's Orchestra Flautist
witch_kings_orchestra_flautist.flavourText: Flautist who once played in their king's orchestra. This nobody has unfortunately seen the spectacle, and is all the more fanatical for it.
abilities: After 2 attacks, the next attack has increased ATK

street_layabout.name: 'Street Layabout'
street_layabout.flavourText: Armed militants disguised as Infected, they are well-acquainted with the local situation. They look no different from ordinary Infected and easily blend into the crowd.
abilities: When attacking targets outside of Realigned Flux, deals a certain percentage of Arts damage

winterwisp_hound.name: Winterwisp Hound
winterwisp_hound.flavourText: A hunting hound trained and utilized by locals since ancient times. For early aboriginals and pioneers, these hounds were considered invaluable partners.

remnant_orchestra_trumpeter.name: Remnant Orchestra Trumpeter
remnant_orchestra_trumpeter.flavourText: Trumpeter who wants to sound their king's triumph. His music is sharp and bright, and he believes himself to be the herald of victory.
abilities: After 2 attacks, the next attack deals splash damage in a cross
Attacks deal Arts damage when passionate variation is active

remnant_orchestra_drummer.name: Remnant Orchestra Drummer
remnant_orchestra_drummer.flavourText: Drummer who wants to set the beat for their king's music. Every beat he drums is filled with pain, for he punishes himself to achieve steady rhythm.
abilities: After 2 attacks, the next attack deals splash damage to all targets in attack range
Attack range increases when passionate variation is active

remnant_orchestra_chorister.name: Remnant Orchestra Chorister
remnant_orchestra_chorister.flavourText: Chorister who wants to sing their king's praise. He tries to write his ode, but every word he pens is as malevolent as any curse.
abilities: After 1 attack, the next attack restores HP based on ATK
Instead restores the HP of this unit and all enemies within attack range when passionate variation is active

remnant_orchestra_wind_player.name: Remnant Orchestra Wind Player
remnant_orchestra_wind_player.flavourText: Wind player who wants to become the concertmaster of their king's orchestra. He worked hard to climb the ladder, but the orchestra is long gone, for which he is very resentful.
abilities: ATK continuously increases when unblocked. ATK is reset after the next attack.
When melancholic variation is active, ATK is greatly increased, and attacks Stun the target

remnant_orchestra_hornist.name: Remnant Orchestra Hornist
remnant_orchestra_hornist.flavourText: Hornist who wants to display his skills under their king. He has never had a chance to show off his talents, and waits for an opportunity to awe the world.
abilities: After 2 attacks, the next attack hits an additional target
Attacks deal Arts damage when passionate variation is active

witch_kings_orchestra_chorister.name: Witch King's Orchestra Chorister
witch_kings_orchestra_chorister.flavourText: Chorister who once sang their king's praise. He has written many odes, but every word he pens is more malevolent than any curse.
abilities: After 1 attack, the next attack restores HP based on ATK
Instead restores the HP of this unit and all enemies within attack range when passionate variation is active

witch_kings_orchestra_trumpeter.name: Witch King's Orchestra Trumpeter
witch_kings_orchestra_trumpeter.flavourText: Trumpeter who once sounded their king's triumph. His music is sharper and brighter, and he has heralded many victories.
abilities: After 2 attacks, the next attack deals splash damage in a cross
Attacks deal Arts damage when passionate variation is active

witch_kings_orchestra_wind_player.name: Witch King's Orchestra Wind Player
witch_kings_orchestra_wind_player.flavourText: Wind player who was once the concertmaster of their king's orchestra. He was once atop the ladder, but the orchestra is long gone, for which he is beyond resentful.
abilities: ATK continuously increases when unblocked. ATK is reset after the next attack.
When melancholic variation is active, ATK is greatly increased, and attacks Stun the target

witch_kings_orchestra_drummer.name: Witch King's Orchestra Drummer
witch_kings_orchestra_drummer.flavourText: Drummer who once set the beat for their king's music. Every beat he drums is filled with suffering, for he torments himself to achieve impeccable rhythm.
abilities: After 2 attacks, the next attack deals splash damage to all targets in attack range
Attack range increases when passionate variation is active

witch_kings_orchestra_hornist.name: Witch King's Orchestra Hornist
witch_kings_orchestra_hornist.flavourText: Hornist who once displayed his skills under their king. He never truly had a chance to show off his talents, and waits for more opportunities to awe the world.
abilities: After 2 attacks, the next attack hits an additional target
Attacks deal Arts damage when passionate variation is active

mass_produced_colossus.name: Mass-Produced Colossus
mass_produced_colossus.flavourText: An Originium Arts creation that sacrifices stability for miniaturization. Well-equipped for breaching, it is often used to break through enemy lines. Like its creator, it is vulnerable to interference from external energy.
abilities: Can only be blocked by units with at least 2 Block
When in Realigned Flux, DEF and RES are greatly reduced

remnant_official_saxophonist.name: Remnant Official Saxophonist
remnant_official_saxophonist.flavourText: Hysterical remnants of the Witch King, they once spent large sums of money to join a certain orchestra in the capital, yet were too impatient to arrange a rehearsal of the saxophone concerto with their sponsor.
abilities: When blowing at full force, fires ranged attacks in all 4 directions, dealing high Physical damage to allies hit. These attacks can be blocked by Realigned Flux

remnant_orchestra_cellist.name: Remnant Orchestra Cellist
remnant_orchestra_cellist.flavourText: Cellist who wants to be their king's trusted henchman. He lives to earn their king's favor, for which he is willing to play obsequious tunes.
abilities: More likely to be attacked by your units

When melancholic variation is active, ATK is greatly increased, and gains a Shield that protects against a certain number of attacks; each time damage is prevented, reflects as Physical damage based on own ATK

remnant_saxophonist.name: Remnant Saxophonist
remnant_saxophonist.flavourText: Irritable remnants of the Witch King, they once attempted to bribe their way into a certain orchestra in the capital. After many years of lying low, they have lost much of their sanity and now try to tear their enemies apart using music itself.
abilities: When blowing at full force, fires ranged attacks in all 4 directions, dealing high Physical damage to allies hit. These attacks can be blocked by Realigned Flux

witch_kings_orchestra_conductor.name: Witch King's Orchestra Conductor
witch_kings_orchestra_conductor.flavourText: Conductor who was once the instrument of their king's will. Having been second only to one, and having gazed upon that elusive spire, he will go to any length to see it again.
abilities: Continuously casts at the nearest Tuning Node you control within attack range to disable it
When the corresponding variation is in effect, greatly increases the max HP of all enemies within attack range

witch_kings_orchestra_cellist.name: Witch King's Orchestra Cellist
witch_kings_orchestra_cellist.flavourText: Cellist who was once their king's trusted henchman. He lives to keep their king's favor, for which he is willing to play loathed tunes.
abilities: More likely to be attacked by your units

When melancholic variation is active, ATK is greatly increased, and gains a Shield that protects against a certain number of attacks; each time damage is prevented, reflects as Physical damage based on own ATK

witch_kings_orchestra_tuner.name: Witch King's Orchestra Tuner
witch_kings_orchestra_tuner.flavourText: Musician who once tuned for their king. He has touched the harmony of origin, and in his hands all sounds may be consonant.
abilities: Continuously casts at the nearest Tuning Node you control within attack range to disable it
When the corresponding variation is in effect, attacks temporarily increase damage taken by your units

remnant_orchestra_conductor.name: Remnant Orchestra Conductor
remnant_orchestra_conductor.flavourText: Conductor who wants to be the instrument of their king's will. Being a conductor is already a rare honor, but he still seeks to climb that great spire, for which he will go to any length.
abilities: Continuously casts at the nearest Tuning Node you control within attack range to disable it
When the corresponding variation is in effect, increases the max HP of all enemies within attack range

devices.description: Less likely to be attacked by your units; can block attacks from the shield side when equipped with a one-way shield (True Damage cannot be blocked)
